components.description_en: Identify migration events that occurred in their neighborhood or community

components.cc_component_description: Use the geologic time scale to organize major events in Earth's history in chronological order

cc_matches.description: The geologic time scale interpreted from rock strata provides a way to organize Earth’s history. Analyses of rock strata and the fossil record provide only relative dates, not an absolute scale.
